assignment_title: Your assignment and a free feedback call
assignment_text:
You leave with a short assignment (30–45 minutes): your own punch card, with your goal and time horizon, five rules every decision must pass, and a study list of three companies or funds you want to learn more about. A study list, not a buy list.

Everyone who submits it can book a free 20-minute call in which I give feedback on your goals and rules.
